abstract: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is the most common subtype of non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Its high genomic and transcriptomic heterogeneity leads to significant differences in clinical phenotypes and prognosis. Traditional bulk sequencing techniques cannot fully resolve heterogeneity at the single-cell level and fail to reveal the interactions and dynamic changes between cells. The breakthrough progress of single-cell sequencing (SCS) technology has provided a new perspective for elucidating the pathogenesis of DLBCL. SCS technology accurately identifies hetero- geneous cell subpopulations at the single-cell level, systematically dissects cellular interactions within the tumor microe- nvironment (TME), reveals the complex changes of tumor cells, optimizes the prognostic evaluation system, and explores new breakthroughs in the study of novel therapeutic targets. This article systematically reviews the cutting-edge progress of SCS technology in DLBCL research, provides a theoretical basis for promoting precise treatment of the disease, and looks forward to the clinical application prospects of multi-omics and spatial transcriptomics technologies.

NlmCategory="UNASSIGNED">弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤(DLBCL)是非霍奇金淋巴瘤最常见的亚型，其基因组和转录组高度异质性致使其临床表型和预后差异显著。传统的批量测序技术无法充分解析单细胞层面的异质性，难以揭示细胞间的相互作用和动态变化。而单细胞测序（SCS）技术的突破性进展，为揭示DLBCL的发病机制提供了全新视角。SCS技术可在单细胞水平上准确识别异质性细胞亚群，系统剖析肿瘤微环境（TME）中不同细胞间的相互作用，揭示肿瘤细胞的复杂变化过程，优化预后评估体系，并为新型治疗靶点的探索带来突破性进展。本文系统综述了SCS技术在DLBCL研究中的前沿进展，为推动疾病精准治疗提供理论依据，并展望多组学与空间转录组学技术的临床应用前景.</AbstractText></OtherAbstract><KeywordList
